---
title: "Dyad Quantitative Consent"
format: dashboard
scrolling: true
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
# Libraries
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
```

<!-- Load data -->

```{r, include = FALSE}
source(here::here("r", "codebook.R"))
source(here::here("r", "add_shade_column_x_rows.R")) # Adding shade to DT tables
source(here::here("r", "quant_dashboard_helpers.R"))

# Enrollment goal in dyads, from the consent form ("approximately 125
# caregiving dyads"). Progress = dyads with both a patient and a caregiver
# consented. Update here if the target changes.
enrollment_goal_dyads <- 125

# DETECT_QUANT_MOCK=1 previews the dashboard with FAKE data from
# data_management/mock_data/make_mock_data.R instead of the REDCap pull.
use_mock <- identical(Sys.getenv("DETECT_QUANT_MOCK"), "1")

data_path <- if (use_mock) {
    here::here("data_management", "mock_data", "quant_consent_mock.RDS")
} else {
    here::here("data", "quant", "quant_consent_cleaned.RDS")
}

data <- readRDS(data_path)

# REDCap pull date is the cleaned file's modified time.
pull_date <- as.Date(file.mtime(data_path))

# Render one page per site from the shared page layout. The All page keeps the
# ALL-ONLY blocks (enrollment goal, by-site breakdown); site pages drop them.
page_template <- paste(
    readLines(here::here("sections", "_consent_page.qmd")),
    collapse = "\n"
)

render_page <- function(title, page_df, is_all = FALSE) {
    body <- if (is_all) {
        page_template
    } else {
        gsub("(?s)<!-- ALL-ONLY-START -->.*?<!-- ALL-ONLY-END -->", "", page_template, perl = TRUE)
    }
    # Drop the template's notes: inside a tabset column a comment becomes an empty tab.
    body <- gsub("(?s)<!--.*?-->", "", body, perl = TRUE)
    body <- gsub("{{GOAL}}", enrollment_goal_dyads, body, fixed = TRUE)
    env <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
    env$page_df <- page_df
    paste0("\n\n# ", title, "\n\n", knit_child(text = body, envir = env, quiet = TRUE))
}
```

#  {.sidebar}

```{r, echo=FALSE}
sidebar_files_box(basename(data_path), pull_date)
sidebar_refs_box(data)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (use_mock) {
    cat('<div class="sidebar-pull"><div class="pull-label">Preview mode</div>',
        '<div class="pull-date">Showing FAKE mock data</div></div>', sep = "")
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat(render_page("All", data, is_all = TRUE))

for (code in names(institution_short)) {
    cat(render_page(institution_short[[code]], data %>% filter(site_code == code)))
}
```
